name: Grandma's Marathon
summary: Grandma's Marathon is held in June, on the third Saturday. It runs point to point from Two Harbors along Scenic Highway 61 and Lake Superior into Canal Park in Duluth. A pacing guide gives a net drop of about 130 ft (about 40 m), with rolling hills in the middle and a short climb at Lemon Drop Hill.
courseHighlights: Start on Lemon Drop Road in Two Harbors
Rolling hills in the middle miles
Finish in Canal Park, near the Aerial Lift Bridge

paceStrategy.summary: The early miles drop gently, which tempts runners to go out fast. Do not bank time there. Run the rolling middle by effort and save your legs for Lemon Drop Hill around mile 22. The last miles ease downhill to the finish.

segments.terrain: Gentle descent, about 100 ft, with some flat sections
segments.advice: Run at or slightly slower than goal pace; do not bank time.
Hold even effort and use the lake breeze.

segments.terrain: Climb to the top of Lemon Drop Hill around mile 22
segments.advice: Shorten your stride and run the hill by effort.

segments.terrain: Mostly flat with downhill stretches into Canal Park
segments.advice: Let the downhill help and push to the finish.

fuelingNotes: Aid stations are about every 2 miles with Gatorade Endurance, and gels are at miles 13 and 20 according to a pacing guide. Take your own gel before Lemon Drop Hill, around mile 19–20.
tips: Buses from the DECC in Duluth are the way to reach the start, so plan early
Wind can matter, as the course runs south-west along the lake
Do not run the early downhill too fast; it can damage your quads
Expect cool starts and warmer finishes, so use a throwaway layer

faq.question: Is Grandma's Marathon net downhill?
faq.answer: Yes. A pacing guide gives a net drop of about 130 ft (about 40 m), though it includes rolling hills and a climb at Lemon Drop Hill.

faq.question: Where is Lemon Drop Hill?
faq.answer: Around mile 22, according to Wikipedia and a pacing guide. It is a short climb late in the race.

faq.question: When is Grandma's Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on the third Saturday in June.
